messages:
Tess (CS): Marta from Helion AP replied: they need a single-page approval that includes the revised pricing and the exact bill-to entity before they can raise the PO. Our DocuSign envelope shows the parent org only.
Eli (AM): Which billing entity do they require?
Marta (Customer Finance): Helion Therapeutics Ltd, VAT GB55-9988. Vendor code: HEL-THER-21. Also they asked that the pricing lines show the mid-term seat adjustment ( +12 seats ) and prorated amount.
Tess (CS): Got it. Envelope id is 2b7e6f9a-11c0-4e7a. They also asked to show the new term end date (2027-02-11) on the stub.
DocuSign Bot: Alert: envelope 2b7e6f9a metadata mismatch detected: billing_entity == "Helion Group".
Rohit (Ops): We can produce a one-page "procurement approval" PDF that references the signed Order Form, lists vendor code, billing entity, line-item prorate, and new term end date. Do they need an executed signature?
Marta (Customer Finance): AP prefers a signature block but will accept a scanned signature for routing. Email to ap@helion.co.uk.
Dana (Legal): Include legal line: "This procurement approval is provided for routing only and does not amend the Master Agreement." Add signer name/title/email and PO number placeholder. If total < $200k we can accept wet-scan with Box upload.
Eli (AM): Renewal total after adjustment is 142000 so wet-scan is acceptable. Quickest path is a PDF stub.
Rohit (Ops): Drafting stub now. I'll include a breakdown: base seats, +12 seats prorated $8,400, support add-on $2,500, total $142,900 (rounded), vendor code HEL-THER-21, bill-to Helion Therapeutics Ltd.
Tess (CS): Offer options to Marta: (A) resend corrected DocuSign envelope with subsidiary metadata, (B) emailed PDF stub to attach to PO, (C) scanned wet-signed attachment. Which is fastest?
Marta (Customer Finance): Option B please. Email PDF to ap@helion.co.uk and cc finance@redwood.com.
Rohit (Ops): Uploaded draft to Box /Approvals/helion/1769009999-procurement-stub.pdf and sent DocSend: https://docsend.com/view/helion-stub-1769009999. Email sent to ap@helion.co.uk.
Dana (Legal): I'll add an audit note approving scanned signature exception and log it in the customer file. Also request billing-ops ticket to fix envelope mapping.
Rohit (Ops): Created OPS-8345 to correct default billing entity for Helion envelopes. Assigned to billing-ops, ETA 2 business days.
Marta (Customer Finance): Received PDF, attaching to our AP workflow. Will update with PO number once issued. :thumbsup:
Tess (CS): Marking resolved pending PO. Reopen if AP rejects attachment or PO mismatches the stub.
